title: Seating Chart Table Reassignment Rate
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:seating table_name=* reassigned=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(reassigned="yes",1,0))) as matched by table_name
| eval a_reassignment_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_reassignment_pct
description: Measures the percentage of seating assignments that end with a reassignment by table.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which table are helping or hurting seating assignments.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a reassignment` on `event:seating` events and summarize the hit rate by `table_name`.
visualization: Table of table with percentage of seating assignments ending with a reassignment.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a reassignment happens for each table so you can see where seating assignments go smoothly or get stuck.
